{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `TxIndex::FindTx` in `src/index/txindex.cpp` (+37/-17) to throw on disk read or corruption errors rather than returning null.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents `TxIndex::FindTx` from silently treating index read failures or corruption as a missing transaction. As noted in the commit message, \"a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception.\""
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` to surface descriptive internal errors and pruned block errors rather than \"not found\".",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Improves RPC response correctness by distinguishing disk read failures from nonexistent transactions. As the author notes, \"Currently the GetTransaction return value is a nullable transaction pointer, where nullptr represents two different outcomes: I/O error and missing tx. Reporting a confirmed transaction as missing is wrong, so properly return an error instead.\""
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The change to `test/functional/test_runner.py` only registers a new functional test for transaction lookup I/O errors and does not alter test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Registering an area-specific functional test does not make a PR part of test infrastructure."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
